2027-01-12.title: Tuesday of the First Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Crowned with glory because of the suffering of death
You have given your Son rule over the works of your hands
He taught them as one having authority
2027-01-12.alt: Weekday of Ordinary Time, Week 1 (Year I). Liturgical colour: green.
2027-01-12.verse: They were astounded at his teaching, for he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
theo: In the synagogue of Capernaum Jesus teaches, and the people are astounded: “he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.” The scribes quoted earlier teachers; Jesus speaks with his own authority, as the Lawgiver himself. Then a man with an unclean spirit cries out, “I know who you are, the Holy One of God.” Jesus silences him with a word and sets the man free. His word is not only true; it is powerful.

Hebrews quotes Psalm 8: “What are human beings that you are mindful of them?” God made us a little lower than the angels and crowned us with glory. But we do not yet see everything subject to us. “But we do see Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death.” He shared our flesh, and “Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters.” The one who speaks with authority is also our brother.
outline: Ask: whose words have authority in your life?
Point 3 · Our brother crowned with glory
Not ashamed to call us brothers and sisters.
“He taught them as one having authority.”
live: Choose one teaching of Jesus you have been ignoring and obey it today.
Pray for those bound by addiction or evil influences.
2027-01-12.prayer: Lord Jesus, Holy One of God, your word has authority over every evil. Speak with authority in my life, set me free from what binds me, and let me live as your brother or sister, crowned with your glory. Amen.
altar: In the Mass Jesus speaks with authority in the Gospel, and with the same authority says over the bread: This is my Body.

quick: Jesus teaches with his own authority.
Crowned with glory, he calls us brothers and sisters.
2027-01-12.action: Obey one teaching of Jesus you have been ignoring.
2027-01-12.question: Does Jesus' word have real authority in my decisions?

family.explain: Jesus taught in the synagogue, and everyone was amazed. A man had an evil spirit, and Jesus commanded it to leave. The man was free!
family.intention: We pray for people who are troubled or afraid.
family.ask: Ask: “Which words of Jesus do we want to obey this week?”

illus: A young man in Kochi struggling with gambling joined a parish recovery group. They read a Gospel passage at every meeting. He said: when I read that the unclean spirit obeyed Jesus, I understood that my addiction is not stronger than him. He has been free for three years.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you teach with authority and set people free. Teach us now, and free us from all that binds us. Amen.
share: He taught them as one having authority (Mark 1:22). Does Jesus' word guide my choices?
Be silent, and come out of him! (Mark 1:25). What do I need to be freed from?
He is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters (Hebrews 2:11). How does it feel to be Jesus' brother or sister?
interc: For preachers and teachers, that they may speak Christ's word faithfully.
For those bound by addiction, fear or evil.
For those who feel unworthy of God's love.
For the suffering, that they may see Jesus crowned through suffering.
For our group, that Jesus' word may have authority among us.
pm.close: Father, your Son speaks with authority and frees us from evil. Make us obedient to his word and glad to be his brothers and sisters. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Jesus enters the synagogue of Capernaum and teaches. The people are astounded, for he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes (Mark 1:22). The scribes quoted others; Jesus speaks in his own name.

Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit shouts: I know who you are, the Holy One of God. Jesus rebukes the spirit: be silent, and come out of him! And the man is set free. Jesus' word does not only inform; it transforms.

Hebrews looks at Psalm 8: what are human beings that you are mindful of them? God crowned us with glory, yet we see so much broken. But we do see Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death (Hebrews 2:9).

And he is not ashamed to call us brothers and sisters (Hebrews 2:11). The one who commands evil spirits is our brother. Let his word have authority in our lives today, and let us trust him to set us free. Amen.
kids: Children, when Jesus spoke, even evil had to obey! Jesus is very strong, and he is also our brother who loves us.

intro: Theme: “He taught them as one having authority.”
The word that frees, and the brother crowned with glory.

q: so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
They were astounded at his teaching, for he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
points.apply: Obey one word of Jesus today.

q: what are human beings that you are mindful of them, mortals that you care for them? Yet you have made them a little lower than God, and crowned them with glory and honor.

but we do see Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.
points.apply: Offer one suffering today in union with Jesus.

q: I will tell of your name to my brothers and sisters; in the midst of the congregation I will praise you:
For the one who sanctifies and those who are sanctified all have one Father. For this reason Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters,
points.apply: Treat a difficult person today as Jesus' brother or sister.

concl: His word has authority over evil.
He is our brother, crowned with glory.
2027-01-12.resolve: Let one teaching of Jesus shape a concrete decision this week.
